description: This file implements an Express.js middleware function 'requireTenant' that enforces tenant identification for incoming requests. It checks for tenant information in JWT tokens, headers, query parameters, or falls back to demo defaults in non-production environments. The middleware attaches tenant info to the request object and sets appropriate response headers. It also handles errors and mismatches in tenant data scenarios.

methods.name: requireTenant(req, res, next)
methods.description: Middleware function that ensures a tenantId is present in the request, resolves it from JWT, headers, or query parameters, and attaches it to the request object. Responds with 400 or 403 on failure or mismatch.
